name: contact-keeper
description: Contact manager built with React, Express, MongoDB and strict TypeScript
author: Ali

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,client "npm run demo -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
